description: Asks how ACE answers SELECT clauses from other SQL dialects and some Jet-only source forms over Dm and One: LIMIT, OFFSET, FETCH FIRST, FIRST and SKIP as modifiers, ROWNUM and ROW_NUMBER, FOR UPDATE and table hints, WITH (a common table expression), VALUES and TABLE statements, GROUP BY ALL, DISTINCT in Sum, Avg and a two-column Count, a derived table with and without an alias and in the bracketed [SELECT ...]. form, HAVING without GROUP BY, an aggregate in WHERE, non-grouped selected columns, star and qualified-star combinations, ORDER BY a position out of range, a string, a collation or NULLS FIRST, and ORDER BY after UNION by a qualified name. Each text is its own snapshot, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
